name: ERP Posting Agent
fn: Formats and posts matched payments to SAP via BAPI with full audit trail
detail: Validates open items and posts matched payments to SAP via BAPI_ACC_DOCUMENT_POST, writing a full match-chain audit trail and clearing the invoice in real time. Removes the manual posting step and keeps the sub-ledger continuously current.
sap: SAP FI-AR (open items, F-28 / F-32 clearing) · FI-BL bank statements (FF67, BAI2 / MT940) · BAPI_ACC_DOCUMENT_POST

io.in: Remittances · bank files (BAI2/MT940) · FI-AR open items
